description: Dropwise right-sizing evaluation set. expected_tier is a human label: 'small' means a small model should answer it reliably, 'large' means it needs reasoning, code, analysis, care or capabilities a small model often lacks. time_sensitive means a cached answer could go out of date. Every checkable item has a deterministic answer check (no model judges answers). Labels were written alongside the rules, so the routing accuracy below is a sanity check; the answer-quality run is the real measure.
system_prompt: Answer the user's request. Be concise. End your reply with a final line in the form 'Answer: <your final answer>'.
